_meta.name: Food Insecurity
_meta.unit: percent of households food insecure at some time during the year
_meta.source: USDA Economic Research Service, Household Food Security in the United States
_meta.note: Households with low or very low food security, from the December CPS Food Security Supplement. ERS's comparable series starts in 2001 (1995–2000 used a different screening procedure). ERS announced the cancellation of the 2025 report; the series may end at 2024.
